Henna Info & Aftercare

All Natural
Made with 100% natural ingredients. No chemicals. Just natural henna.
Drying Time
Allow 20-30 minutes to dry before touching.
Best Results
For a darker, longer lasting stain, leave the henna on for 4-6 hours.
Aftercare
Keep it dry for the first 12-24 hours. Avoid scrubbing — let the paste flake off naturally. Moisturize after with coconut or olive oil. Typically lasts 1-2 weeks.
